subject: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps

Hi Samantha - thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

1) Goals / primary use cases
- Customer support triage: ingest user transcripts, generate suggested replies (chat/completion)
- Knowledge base search + rerank for top-N retrieval (embeddings + reranker)
- Short-form summarization for internal tickets (chat/summary)

2) Expected monthly volume (your estimates)
- Chat/completions (user-facing suggestions): ~18M input tokens, ~36M output tokens (~54M total)
- Embeddings (kb indexing + similarity): ~6M embedding vectors/month (text)
- Rerank (per-search rerank calls): ~1.2M short-rerank requests/month

3) Model mix you're considering
- chat: mix of 2x low-latency chat variants for real-time suggestions (~70% of chat traffic) and 1x higher-quality chat for escalations (~30%)
- embeddings: single medium-size embedding model for recall (~100% of embedding traffic)
- rerank: lightweight reranker model optimized for throughput (~100% rerank)

4) Budget & unit economics (what you told us)
- Target spend band: $20k-$35k/month initially
- Target blended unit goal: ~$3,500-$4,500 per 1M tokens (blended across chat variants + embeddings approximated into token units)

Next steps I'll take:
- Share a short pricing proposal + per-model unit economics and 12-month projection (attached)
- Vivek will follow up with model-compatibility notes and recommended quantization/profile for your latency SLOs
- Can we target a follow-up next Wed (Dec 2) to review pricing and finalize a pilot scope?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Proposal_BrightLayer_v1.pdf (proposal), token_volume_estimates_brightlayer.xlsx (workbook with token math)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer Billing <billing@brightlayer.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps

Thanks Marissa - this looks right and appreciated the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- The chat token split: your 54M total tokens/month is a good working estimate; of that, roughly 80% will be standard suggestions (lower context, <256 tokens output) and 20% will be escalation/longer responses (higher context, ~1k tokens output).
- Embeddings: 6M vectors is the peak index + incremental updates; initial pilot will likely be 2-3M/month and then ramp.
- Rerank: 1.2M is correct; these are lightweight calls (~64 tokens each).

Budget: we can stretch to the upper end of the band if the per-model numbers make sense. Please send the per-model $/1M token breakdown - we need to evaluate ops and product budgets separately.

Also looping in billing (cc) - they'll want the formal quote and any notes on overage handling.

Appreciate it - Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Product | BrightLayer
Samantha.Lee@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, BrightLayer Billing <billing@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps

Thanks Sam - attached is the pricing proposal (PDF) plus the token estimates workbook. Key highlights (per-model unit economics, monthly projection at stated volumes):

- Chat_lowlat (low-latency chat variant): $2,800 per 1M tokens
- Chat_highqual (high-quality variant for escalations): $6,500 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings_medium: $1,200 per 1M embedding-vector-equivalent (we map embeddings to token-equivalents in the workbook)
- Rerank_light: $900 per 1M token-equivalents

Blended example (using your current mix):
- Chat (54M tokens total): assuming 70% on lowlat / 30% on highqual => blended chat cost ~($2,800*0.7 + $6,500*0.3) = ~$3,670 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (6M vectors): mapped to an equivalent of ~12M token-units (see workbook) => cost ~ $1,200 * 12 = $14,400/month
- Rerank (1.2M calls): equivalent token-units ~1.2M => $900 * 1.2 = $1,080/month

Projected monthly spend (rounded): "
- Chat: 54M tokens => 54 * $3,670 = ~$198,180/month
- Embeddings: ~$14,400/month
- Rerank: ~$1,080/month

Total: ~$213.6k/month at stated run rate (this is a full production estimate). I know this is above your initial band - there are clear levers to get into your target range (batching, prefix caching, more aggressive quantization for the high-volume chat paths, or shifting higher-volume traffic to a lower-cost chat variant). 

For a pilot we often recommend: 
- Limit production region routing to one region to avoid cross-region egress
- Use 8-bit quantized weights + Redwood's preferred kernel path for chat_lowlat (saves ~30% cost)
- Configure automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (user templates) - this can drop token bill by up to ~25% for template-heavy flows

I'll also attach a 12-month forecast that models a pilot with 50% of the stated volumes and targeted optimizations - that gets you into the $30-40k/month ballpark for months 1-3.

Next: please confirm which chat variant split you expect to use in the pilot (we need exact percentages to generate a pilot quote and an initial Dedicated capacity recommendation).

Thanks,
Marissa

---
Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Proposal_BrightLayer_v1.pdf, token_volume_estimates_brightlayer.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightlayer.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, BrightLayer Billing <billing@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps

Hi Sam - quick technical follow-up from the infra side. Two notes that will materially impact unit economics: 

1) Model mixing: if 80% of chat traffic is short-context suggestions as you said, we can configure a low-cost chat runtime (aggressive batching + 8-bit quant) and pin the remaining 20% to a higher-accuracy variant that uses larger context windows. That split will decrease blended cost substantially. For the pilot, please confirm the pilot split (Marissa asked for percentages) - sample pilot: 85% lowlat / 15% highqual.

2) Embedding strategy: for initial indexing, we recommend using a slightly cheaper embedding flavor for batch re-indexing and reserving the higher-quality embedding for online similarity lookups. If you decide to use two embedding variants, send expected split (ex: 80/20 batch/online).

Technical ask: can you provide a sample breakdown of chat traffic by utterance length (percent of calls <256 tokens vs >512)? That will let us calibrate batching and caching savings and give you a tighter per-1M token target.

Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer Billing <billing@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightLayer model mix & pricing - token volumes + next steps

Thanks Vivek - quick answers from our side: 

- Pilot chat split: we'll go with 80% lowlat / 20% highqual for the pilot. That aligns with our product risk appetite.
- Chat token lengths: ~82% of calls are short (<256 tokens total), ~12% mid (256-512), ~6% long (>512).
- Embedding split for pilot: start with single embedding model (100% on embeddings_medium) - we'll evaluate dual-embedding approach in Q2 if recall problems appear.

Accepting Marissa's recommendation to run a 3-month pilot at 50% of stated volumes with the optimizations you suggested. Please send a pilot quote (per-month) and the draft contract/DocuSign link and we'll route to our procurement.

Sam

Next steps captured: Marissa to send pilot quote and DocuSign link; Vivek to provide runtime configuration notes for pilot.
